Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia (low oxygen saturation), mild leukopenia and neutropenia, mild thrombocytopenia, monocytosis, basophilia, and mild eosinophilia. Glucose is slightly low. Alkaline phosphatase is elevated, while ALT is low. No evidence of SARS-CoV-2 infection. Findings may suggest a viral infection or bone marrow suppression; clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
